items.title: "Pete" Ferdinand Valentine Interview, 1960-06-24
items.q: I used to play a parade. With Max, he came here and played a parade.

ctx.x: Yeah. Did you have any teacher when you first started music?

No, I just learned by what Dijon, he just, and mostly, he just, who's that? Who's that, huh? Yeah. That's you. Oh, that's you. Yeah, he teach the whole band after the lines good from the professor. Well, he just, you know, pick me up and give me the attitude. You never really play trumpet then? No, I play a little ball. Yeah, I play with Thomas, a little ball, okay, yeah. I play trumpet, yeah. I play trumpet. I used to play a parade. With Max, he came here and played a parade. You get on the other parade, we…
And what other instruments did you play? You must play several, huh?
